meta.title: Recreate Order: Use Custom Event End Time with a very large number

plan.title: Recreate Order with Large Custom Duration

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where Vendor A's bid is shown.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: In the open Recreate Order window, select Custom under Event End Time Duration, enter 999999 in the custom duration input, enter 30 in Evaluation Duration, select 15 May 2027 as the Delivery Date, click Create Order, and record the resulting success, validation, refusal, or navigation outcome shown by the screen.

steps.note: Perform the custom-duration scenario and capture exactly how Procol responds to the very large value.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw values, or rendering failure.
